BrochureContent.Content:
103 Riverchapel View, is an excellent opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented spacious detached three-bedroom bungalow, ideally situated in the ever-popular Riverchapel Wood development. This attractive development is renowned for its generous open spaces and convenient location, making it a highly sought-after choice for both permanent residents and those seeking a holiday home by the sea.
Located just minutes' walk from Riverchapel Village, the property enjoys easy access to a host of local amenities including shops, school, churches, pharmacy and pub. Ardamine Beach and Courtown Village & Harbour are also within easy walking distance, offering beautiful coastal walks, beaches and a variety of leisure amenities.
The vibrant town of Gorey is approximately a five-minute drive away and provides an extensive range of shopping, dining and recreational facilities, together with excellent bus and rail connections and convenient access to the M11 motorway.
The well-proportioned accommodation comprises a welcoming bright entrance hallway, a bright open-plan living/dining/kitchen area with a solid fuel stove in the living area and a modern fitted kitchen and ample room for a family dining table. From the dining area sliding doors open onto an enclosed west facing patio. There are three generous bedrooms all with fitted wardrobes and the master bedroom benefiting from an en-suite, and a spacious family bathroom.
Outside the landscaped west facing enclosed rear patio is ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining.
This wonderful home will appeal to a wide range of purchasers, whether looking for a private residence, coastal getaway or holiday home in one of Ireland's most popular seaside locations.

 Excellent Location close to Ardamine Beach
 Close to Riverchapel village amenities
 50 Min from M50/South Dublin
